stem: A central venous line is inserted above the first rib and pleural air is suspected after the procedure. Which structure is at risk near the lung apex?

options.label: A
options.explanation: It surrounds the heart in the mediastinum, not the lung apex.

options.label: B
options.explanation: It forms the floor of the thorax and is not at the lung apex.

options.label: C
options.explanation: It lines the mediastinal surface of the lung but is not the apical projection at the root of the neck.

options.label: D
options.explanation: It extends above the first rib over the lung apex and can be injured by low-neck procedures.

options.label: E
options.explanation: It is a connective-tissue layer but not the pleural sac that contains the lung.

context: The cervical pleura projects above the first rib, so procedures at the root of the neck can enter the pleural cavity.
